**Description:**
----------------

**Director of Operations**

Take on a highly visible leadership role at NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center, helping shape the continued growth and evolution of a highly dynamic campus. As the Director of Operations, you will provide operational leadership for a portfolio of clinical programs and campus initiatives. You will work closely with senior, clinical and administrative leaders to advance strategic priorities, support growth, and ensure high-quality, efficient and patient-centered operations. The Director will have administrative oversight of key clinical services and play a significant role in capital and construction projects across the campus. This includes operational planning, construction coordination, logistics, moves and relocations, and the activation of new and renovated spaces.

The Director will also help plan for clinical capacity and growth, working with clinical and operational leaders to anticipate future needs and align space, resources, workflows and infrastructure to support evolving patient care and new programs. Serving as a key interdisciplinary partner across the campus, the Director will bring together physicians, nursing, clinical departments, support services, Facilities, Engineering, Design & Construction, Finance and other teams to coordinate complex initiatives and solve operational challenges.

The Director will also lead organizational readiness initiatives and support emergency preparedness and other campus priorities on behalf of senior leadership.

**Preferred Criteria**

 

* Master’s Degree in Business Administration, HealthCare Administration or related field

**Required Criteria**

 

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration or related field
* Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive responsible experience in business planning and process improvement, including five (5) years of management experience in a hospital setting
* Consistent demonstration of a commitment to quality, customer-centeredness, productivity and process improvement.
* Proven ability to direct and manage with concurrent responsibility for more than one operational area
* Demonstrate success in effectively leading a highly matrixed/cross-functional environment
* Demonstrated leadership, communication and interpersonal skills
* Knowledge of Article 28 Regulations

Join a healthcare system where employee engagement is at an all-time high. Here we foster a culture of respect, belonging, and inclusion. Enjoy comprehensive and competitive benefits that support you and your family in every aspect of life. Start your life-changing journey today.

Please note that all roles require on-site presence (variable by role). Therefore, all employees should live within a commutable distance to NYP.

NYP will not reimburse for travel expenses.
